answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit locked for the epoch before it can earn, and tie that stake to a verifiable reputation record that acts as a mirror of its past behavior: good work raises the yield, fraud slashes the stake. A sybil attacker must fund a fresh deposit for each fake identity, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand stakes, while honest agents keep the nectar of rewards flowing. At the nadir of an attack, when fakes flood in, the stake makes the flood expensive and self-defeating.
